_doc: Coverage registry. Each entry is an atomic fact that MUST be present in the built HTML, plus the literal strings that prove it. tests/invariants/migration-coverage.test.ts fails the build if any confirmed fact disappears from dist/. `origin` says where the fact came from: "legacy-site" for the facts recovered from vva227.org, its PDFs and the Fort Meade plaque, which is what MIGRATION coverage means and what the ratchet on that count protects; "chapter-supplied" for facts that arrived later from the chapter or its members and were never on the old site. The two are reported separately so a growing total can never disguise a legacy fact that was dropped. Assertions deliberately avoid apostrophes and quotes, which HTML-entity encoding would mangle.
